# Aspiron Education

> Aspiron Education (aspironeducation.com) is an Indian online platform for NEET (UG) and JEE Main preparation. Students take exam-style computer-based (CBT) mock tests and test series on any phone or computer and get an instant result, rank among Aspiron students, solutions and a subject-wise and chapter-wise analysis. Tests are offered in English and Hindi (हिंदी) medium where a series includes both. Test series are bought on the Store with UPI.

Key facts:
- Brand name: Aspiron Education (short: Aspiron). Website: https://aspironeducation.com/
- Exams: NEET (UG) and JEE Main.
- Features: full-length and chapter-wise CBT mock tests, instant result, rank, solutions, mistakes list, previous year questions (PYQ), question bank, installable web app with notifications.
- Languages: English and Hindi.
- Support: WhatsApp and Telegram (see the Contact page). Social: Instagram @aspironeducation, WhatsApp channel, Telegram.
- Prices and the tests inside each series change over time; the Store shows the current details.

## Test series
- [NEET Test Series](https://aspironeducation.com/neet-test-series): NEET (UG) online CBT mock tests in the NTA pattern (180 questions, 720 marks, +4/−1).
- [NEET टेस्ट सीरीज़ (हिंदी)](https://aspironeducation.com/hi/neet-test-series): the NEET page in Hindi.
- [JEE Main Test Series](https://aspironeducation.com/jee-test-series): JEE Main CBT mock tests (75 questions, 300 marks, +4/−1).
- [Store](https://aspironeducation.com/store): all current test series with price, and buying with UPI.
